YOUR PERSONAL RIDE CAPTAIN

A check-in for every journey.

Each booking receives its own automated Captain. During your ride, Captain asks how it is going and checks in again about five minutes after your reply while the app stays open.

All goodI need helpI feel unsafe

Choose Chat with Captain on your booking to reply, ask about your trip or report a concern.

Captain is an automated assistant. Help reports are recorded for manual review. For urgent help, use SOS. A real booking is required to start a conversation.

✓ Know your safety tools
01

Trip-start PIN

Your driver must enter the six-digit PIN shown in your booking to start your journey. Share it after checking the driver and vehicle.

02

Ladies rides

For verified women riders with a verified woman driver and an all-women travelling party. Availability depends on a matching Ladies offer.

03

Share your journey

Create a revocable link from My trips. Driver location appears while they share it. Links expire after two hours or when the trip ends.

04

Emergency help

SOS gives you access to 112 calling, location sharing and your trusted contact. You choose when to place a call or send a message.

Opening SOS does not automatically contact police or send an alert.

WE’RE LISTENING

Report a concern

Reports are stored for operator review. For immediate danger, call 112. This form is not a monitored emergency channel.
